title: SPARC VORTEX vs NFW: analysis code and results
description: Reproducible analysis comparing a curl-free VORTEX dark-halo profile against the standard NFW profile on 171 SPARC galaxies. Key results (corrected optimiser, v2): VORTEX success rate 81.9% (140/171) vs NFW 79.5% (136/171) at chi2/dof < 3; median chi2/dof 1.066 vs 1.190; aggregate Delta BIC = +1549 in favour of VORTEX, with 95% bootstrap CI [-558, +4208] and P(Delta BIC > 0) = 0.61; head-to-head BIC wins 104/171. Note: v1 of this analysis (submitted 2026-09-21 to MNRAS) contained a systematic error in the NFW optimiser that did not converge for 54% of the sample; see erratum_note.pdf for full root-cause analysis.
references: Lelli F., McGaugh S. S., Schombert J. M., 2016, AJ, 152, 157
McGaugh S. S., Lelli F., Schombert J. M., 2016, PRL, 117, 201101
Navarro J. F., Frenk C. S., White S. D. M., 1996, ApJ, 462, 563
